verdict.rationale: Codex has no documented native rule or trigger engine. Event-driven automation is only reachable indirectly: `codex exec` can be called non-interactively from scripts, CI and pipelines, which external CI systems can fire on events. Cloud tasks can also start from GitHub PRs, GitLab MRs, Linear issues or Slack threads, though these read as user-initiated starts rather than configurable automatic rules. Missing for 10: a native way to define event→action rules or hooks, documented automatic triggering from GitHub/Slack/Linear events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
